name: Gargi Puruskar Yojana
benefit: Payable for 11 & 12 class girl students: Rs. 3,000/- each year on the day of Basant Panchami.
eligibility_rules: The student must have secured minimum 75% marks in class 10th. The girl student should be studying regularly in class 11 or
There is no restriction on income, occupation and caste etc. of the parents of the student.
documents_required: Marksheet / Certificate Copy. Aadhar Card Copy. Bank Passbook Copy. Jan Aadhar/Bhamashah Card Copy.
how_to_apply: Mode: Online Scholarship Application online through School Principal on Shaladarpan Portal. Click on "Balika Shiksha Protsahan" or click here. Select the scheme and click on apply button. Now select the scheme name. Fill out the required details and process further.
